sources.title: The Principles of Etiquette
sources.author: Emily Post Institute
sources.supported_use: Distinguish a purpose of courtesy from a particular manner.
sources.limits: Normative advice, not universal cultural evidence or a first-impression outcome guarantee.

sources.title: What is emotional abuse?
sources.author: National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.supported_use: Attend to control, threats and affection used for pressure.
sources.limits: US relationship-abuse context; no diagnostic checklist, jurisdictional legal conclusion or individualized risk assessment.

sources.title: What is gaslighting?
sources.author: National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.sections: Techniques, gradual patterns and help section
sources.supported_use: Reality-undermining patterns; ordinary disagreement alone is insufficient.
sources.limits: The provider includes attributed material; no independent clinical validation claimed, no person diagnosed from seven examples.

sources.title: Technology Safety Plan: A Guide for Survivors and Advocates
sources.author: NNEDV Safety Net Project
sources.sections: Prioritize Safety, including safer devices and strategic planning around technology
sources.supported_use: Safer contact and individualized advice before potentially consequential technology changes.
sources.limits: US resources require local verification; no digital safety guarantee. Documentation/investigation instructions are not imported as an exercise.

sources.title: How To Avoid a Scam
sources.author: Federal Trade Commission
sources.supported_use: Pause and check a claimed deadline through an independent route.
sources.limits: Consumer-fraud context, not relationship diagnosis; real deadlines exist.

sources.title: The logic of indirect speech
sources.author: Pinker, Nowak and Lee (2008)
sources.supported_use: Language can convey information while negotiating relationships.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; no universal cue decoder, consent inference or endorsement of manipulation. No full-text methods review claimed.

sources.title: Autobiography of Intercultural Encounters
sources.author: Council of Europe / Byram and colleagues (2009)
sources.sections: Introduction to one specific encounter, reflection sections
sources.supported_use: Ground reflection in a particular encounter rather than a group stereotype.
sources.limits: Not a national communication taxonomy or outcome validation. Original exercises here; questionnaire not reproduced.

sources.title: Communication Access
sources.author: American Speech-Language-Hearing Association
sources.supported_use: Ask preferences, communicate directly and enable both understanding and expression.
sources.limits: Healthcare-oriented guidance applied cautiously to an informal task, not clinical care or certification.

sources.title: Making Events Accessible
sources.author: W3C Web Accessibility Initiative
sources.sections: Planning, access requirements, advance material, interpreting/captioning and activities
sources.supported_use: Prepare usable material and arrangements, then check actual participation.
sources.limits: Event guidance does not certify a venue or establish universal access. No learning-styles claim or legal-compliance assertion imported.

sources.title: National CLAS Standards
sources.author: US HHS Office of Minority Health
sources.supported_use: Qualified language-assistance boundary; avoid default use of untrained people or minors.
sources.limits: Health and healthcare context; not a universal law for informal groups or a substitute for applicable service requirements.

sources.title: Mistakenly Seeking Solitude
sources.author: Epley and Schroeder (2014)
sources.supported_use: A reason to question some pessimistic predictions about ordinary contact.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use, specific experimental settings; no guarantee that a particular person welcomes approach, no dose or contact quota.

sources.title: How many hours does it take to make a friend?
sources.author: Jeffrey A. Hall (online 2018; issue 2019)
sources.type: primary observational research, selected sections inspected
sources.supported_use: Shared activity and time can be considered alongside conduct across encounters.
sources.limits: Associations, recalled hours and selected samples; no causal hour threshold or certification of friendship. Full methods not independently audited.

sources.title: A new look at social support: a theoretical perspective on thriving through relationships
sources.author: Feeney and Collins (online 2014; issue 2015)
sources.supported_use: Support as a process in adversity and growth opportunities.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; does not validate six support modes, legacy timing, this exercise or clinical outcomes.

sources.title: A Theory of Communal (and Exchange) Relationships
sources.author: Clark and Mills (2012)
sources.type: primary theory chapter, selected pages inspected
sources.supported_use: Distinguish need-responsive benefits from comparable repayment norms.
sources.limits: Opening conceptual pages only, not a full empirical review. Does not erase agreements, capacity limits or exploitation.

sources.title: Plan for Safety
sources.author: National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.sections: Individualized planning, responsibility for abuse and contact options
sources.supported_use: Use individualized support instead of compelled confrontation or immediate exit.
sources.limits: US service context; verify locality and safe contact. No personalized plan or guarantee. Browser-history clearing is not presented as protection.
